parts.style: warm, gentle bedtime welcome, speaking slowly
parts.text: Hello again, my friend. <short pause> Is your pillow just right? <short pause> Good. <short pause> Tonight's story is about a kind shepherd, and one little sheep who wandered away.

Once there was a shepherd who had one hundred sheep. <short pause> One hundred! <short pause> Big sheep and little sheep. <short pause> Fluffy sheep and sleepy sheep. <short pause> And the shepherd knew every single one of them.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Every day, he led them to green grass to eat, and to cool water to drink. <short pause> And every evening, when the sun went down, he brought them home and counted them, one by one, as they went through the gate.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly

parts.text: The shepherd stopped. <short pause> He looked around. <short pause> Ninety-nine? <short pause> Where was number one hundred?

One little sheep was missing. <short pause> She had wandered off to nibble some flowers, and then a little farther, and a little farther still... <short pause> until she looked up, and she couldn't see the others anymore.

Now, the shepherd still had ninety-nine sheep, safe and sound. <short pause> But he didn't say, Oh well, that's enough. <short pause> No. <short pause> He made sure the others were safe, and then he picked up his lantern and went out into the night to find the one that was lost.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: He walked over the hills. <short pause> He looked behind the rocks. <short pause> He called her name, softly, into the dark. <short pause> And far away, in a thorny bush, a small, tired voice answered... <short pause> baa.

The shepherd found her! <short pause> He untangled her wool from the thorns, very gently. <short pause> He didn't scold her. <short pause> He lifted her up onto his shoulders, and carried her all the way home.

parts.style: warm, joyful but soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: When he got home, he called to his friends and neighbors. <short pause> Come and celebrate with me! <short pause> I have found my little sheep!

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: He set her down in the soft straw, right in the middle of the flock. <short pause> The other sheep snuggled close around her, warm and woolly. <short pause> And the little sheep gave a big, sleepy yawn.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Do you know what this story means, my friend? <short pause> It means that you matter, just like that one little sheep. <short pause> If you ever feel far away, or lost, or alone, the people who love you will always come looking for you. <short pause> Every single time.
Let's count slowly, like the shepherd, and let your body get heavy and still. <short pause> One... <short pause> two... <short pause> three... <short pause> four... <short pause> five.
All one hundred sheep are home now. <short pause> The gate is closed. <short pause> The stars are shining. <short pause> And you are safe, too. <short pause> Goodnight, my friend.
